title: Uninterrupted terminal geometry
caveat: One clean lower-leg taper. This is a geometry detail, not a full-body proportion guide.

title: Initial contact
caveat: Intact point at first contact. Use written low-origin rule for subsequent emergence.

title: Lateral hyphal emergence
caveat: Distinction between point and lateral filaments. The visible emergence zone should be tightened to immediately above the substrate.

title: Clean airborne release
caveat: Clean point after release. Any residual substrate filaments are separate from the lifted leg.

title: Standing body and leg mass
path: References/Details/C09 Standing body and leg mass.png
caveat: Body mass and existing clean pointed endings only. Cap and part of the gesture are deliberately outside the crop. Slim the calves to the selected proportional target; this is not a measured or complete turnaround.

caveat: Selected leg-length and taper relationship. This narrow crop excludes the earlier cap and printed annotations. Visible angular internal lines are not approved; upper-leg volume hidden by the skirt is not inferred.
